facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Toad drove too fast again. The police caught him. He had to pay money. Toad got in trouble.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Toad was driving his car much too fast as usual. He almost crashed into another car on the road. A policeman stopped him and was very angry. Toad got in trouble and had to pay a fine. But Toad did not feel sorry at all about what happened. His friends worried that worse trouble was coming soon.
